npp-plugins.description:
Connect your AI assistant to Nextpad++. Implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP) so Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code agents and Windsurf can see the documents you have open - live, including unsaved edits - and, with your permission, edit them.

Features:
- Reads the active tab, your selection, the lines around your caret, and every open tab (untitled scratch tabs included)
- Search the active document or all open tabs at once; find-and-replace across every open tab
- Precise write-back: multi-line edits land as a single undo (cross-tab replace is one undo per tab), guarded by a content checksum so an assistant never clobbers your typing
- Creates tabs, sets syntax languages, opens/saves/closes/reloads files
- Permissions: read-only out of the box; editing, tab creation and file operations are three separate opt-in switches, and a tool you haven't granted is invisible to the assistant
- Local-only and private: binds 127.0.0.1 behind a personal bearer token, no cloud, no code execution, and every request appears in the panel's live activity log
- One-click client setup snippets for Claude Code, Cursor / VS Code and Claude Desktop (stdio bridge included)

Universal binary (Apple Silicon + Intel), macOS 12+.
